caption: A red ball rolls along a hallway of polished steel panels, and a blurry reflection rolls alongside in each panel.

sa.check: A ball rolls along a hallway of polished steel panels.
A reflection rolls alongside in each panel.

pc.expect: Each panel shows a copy of the ball moving in step, and the copies vanish at the gaps between panels.
pc.fail: A copy stays still while the ball rolls; or a copy shows across a gap; or a panel shows no copy.

pc.expect: Each copy is a mirrored, slightly warped red ball.
pc.fail: A copy is a different colour; or a different object; or perfectly sharp on a plainly brushed surface.

pc.expect: The ball rolls straight and slows gently.
pc.fail: It curves; or speeds up; or restarts.
A panel ripples; or bends; or the ball dents it.

pc.expect: One ball and one copy per panel.
pc.fail: A second ball appears in the hallway; or a copy steps out; or the ball vanishes; or the ball passes into a panel.

pc.expect: The ball's colour and the hallway stay the same.
pc.fail: The ball changes colour; or the panels change; or the hallway rearranges.
